# Loyal Spark — Onchain Loyalty Protocol (Full Reference)

> Loyalty-as-a-Service for AI agents and merchants on Base L2. Two API personas: **merchant** (`lsk_` — issue and manage loyalty programs) and **recipient** (`rwk_` — wallet that holds loyalty tokens, redeems rewards, trades P2P). Deploy ERC-20 tokens, manage rewards, earn points from purchases, trade on P2P marketplace — via REST API, MCP Server, or pay-per-request gateways (MPP / x402 v2).

## Overview

Loyal Spark is a dual-mode protocol: humans interact via web UI with flexible authentication (email/phone/Google via Privy with embedded wallets, or SIWE for Farcaster and crypto-native users), while AI agents integrate via REST API, MCP Server, or HTTP 402 payment gateways. The protocol runs on Base mainnet (chain ID 8453) and uses ERC-20 tokens for loyalty points.

## Discovery Endpoints

- Onboarding (web): https://loyalspark.online/for-agents

- Recipient MCP Server (`rwk_`, 17 tools): https://api.loyalspark.online/recipient-loyalty-mcp (Streamable HTTP)
- REST (merchant, `lsk_`, 25 authenticated routes + 1 public): https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-api
- REST (recipient, `rwk_`, 12 routes): https://api.loyalspark.online/recipient-api
- MPP Manifest: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/mpp.json
- x402 Resources: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/x402.json (Bazaar-discoverable URLs for both merchant and recipient corridors)
- AI Plugin: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/ai-plugin.json
- Skills Guide: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/skills/index.md

## Authentication

Two key prefixes for two roles:

- **`lsk_…`** — merchant agent: issues programs, mints tokens, manages rewards. All `agent-api/*` and `loyalty-mcp` paths require `x-api-key: lsk_…` (only `GET /vouchers/status` is public).
- **`rwk_…`** — recipient agent: a wallet that *holds* loyalty tokens. All `recipient-api/*` and `recipient-loyalty-mcp` paths require `x-api-key: rwk_…`.

How to get a key:
1. **Dashboard (humans):** sign in at https://loyalspark.online/merchant (Privy: email/phone/Google/wallet) → "AI Agents" tab → register → copy `lsk_…` (shown once).
2. **Autonomous (no browser):** SIWE flow at `agent-register-siwe` — `POST /siwe-nonce` → sign EIP-4361 message including `Register Loyal Spark merchant agent` (or `…recipient agent`) and Chain ID 8453 → POST signature → receive `lsk_…` or `rwk_…`. Same limits as dashboard.

## REST API — 26 Endpoints (25 authenticated + 1 public)

Base URL: https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-api

### Read Operations (GET)

| Endpoint | Price | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| /me | free | Agent profile, plan, wallet info |
| /programs | $0.001 | List active loyalty programs |
| /rewards?token_address=0x... | $0.001 | Rewards for a program |
| /balance?token_address=0x...&wallet_address=0x... | $0.001 | Token balance and tier |
| /customers?token_address=0x... | $0.002 | Customer list with balances |
| /vouchers?token_address=0x... | $0.001 | Voucher list |
| /vouchers/status?code=LOYAL-XXXX | free | Public voucher status check (no API key) |
| /analytics?token_address=0x... | $0.005 | Program metrics |
| /offers | $0.001 | Active P2P marketplace offers |
| /tx-receipt?tx_hash=0x... | free | Extract token_address from deploy tx |

### Write Operations (POST)

| Endpoint | Price | Scope | Description |
|----------|-------|-------|-------------|
| /programs | $0.05 | mint | Get calldata to deploy new ERC-20 token |
| /register-program | $0.01 | mint | Register deployed token (optional cashback_rate, points_per_dollar) |
| /update-program-config | $0.005 | mint | Update program cashback_rate and/or points_per_dollar |
| /activate-program | $0.01 | mint | Get activation calldata (unpause + enable minting) |
| /program-status | $0.005 | mint | Update program status |
| /rewards | $0.01 | manage_rewards | Create a redeemable reward |
| /mint | $0.01 | mint | Mint tokens to customer wallet |
| /earn | $0.01 | mint | Auto-calculate and mint tokens from purchase amount × cashback rate |
| /transfer | $0.005 | mint | Transfer tokens between wallets |
| /offers | $0.01 | trade | Create P2P escrow offer |
| /accept-offer | $0.01 | trade | Accept a P2P offer |
| /redeem-reward | $0.01 | read | Redeem reward: verify tx + create voucher |
| /vouchers/use | $0.005 | manage_rewards | Mark voucher as used |
| /cancel-offer | $0.005 | trade | Cancel your P2P offer |
| /merchant-profile (GET) | $0.001 | read | Read merchant profile |
| /merchant-profile (POST) | $0.005 | manage_rewards | Create merchant profile |
| /merchant-profile (PUT) | $0.005 | manage_rewards | Update merchant profile |

### Example: Mint Tokens

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "x-api-key: lsk_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token_address":"0x...","recipient_address":"0x...","amount":100}' \
  https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-api/mint
```

Response returns calldata with Builder Code for onchain execution.

## MCP Server — 35 Tools (Merchant)

URL: https://api.loyalspark.online/loyalty-mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP
Auth: x-api-key header

### Tools

1. `get_platform_info` — Protocol metadata and capabilities
2. `get_my_profile` — Agent identity, plan, wallet
3. `list_loyalty_programs` — All active programs
4. `create_loyalty_program` — Deploy calldata for new token
5. `register_loyalty_program` — Register deployed token (optional cashback_rate, points_per_dollar)
6. `activate_loyalty_program` — Activation calldata
7. `update_program_status` — Update status in DB
8. `update_program_config` — Update cashback_rate / points_per_dollar in DB
9. `list_rewards` — Rewards for a program (with redemption metrics)
10. `create_reward` — Create redeemable reward
11. `mint_loyalty_tokens` — Mint calldata with platform fee
12. `earn_points` — Auto-calculate and mint tokens from purchase amount (cashback)
13. `transfer_loyalty_tokens` — Transfer calldata
14. `get_token_balance` — Balance and tier info
15. `get_program_analytics` — Metrics and performance
16. `get_platform_stats` — Global platform statistics (admin-only)
17. `list_marketplace_offers` — P2P offers
18. `cancel_stale_offers` — Cancel old marketplace offers (admin-only)
19. `redeem_reward` — Redeem reward: verify tx + create voucher
20. `use_voucher` — Mark voucher as used
21. `check_voucher_status` — Public voucher status lookup (no API key)
22. `create_personalized_offer` — Create targeted offer for a customer
23. `update_reward_status` — Activate/deactivate rewards
24. `export_customers` — Export customer data for analytics
25. `send_report` — Submit report to developer dashboard
26. `list_my_reports` — View previously submitted reports
27. `update_report_status` — Update report status (reviewed/done)
28. `delete_report` — Delete an outdated report
29. `create_gift_certificate` — Issue gift / welcome certificate (LOYAL-XXXXXX), single or batch up to 100
30. `list_gift_certificates` — List certificates issued by your merchant (with status + redemption info)
31. `revoke_gift_certificate` — Revoke an active gift certificate (active → revoked)
32. `mark_gift_certificate_minted` — Mark a claimed certificate as minted with the on-chain mint tx (pending_mint → redeemed)

## Recipient MCP Server — 17 Tools (Holder, `rwk_`)

URL: https://api.loyalspark.online/recipient-loyalty-mcp

1. `get_recipient_profile` — Bound wallet + agent metadata
2. `list_my_loyalty_balances` — All loyalty token balances for the wallet
3. `get_my_loyalty_balance` — Balance + tier for one token
4. `prepare_loyalty_token_transfer` — ERC-20 transfer calldata (holder → any address)
5. `list_rewards_for_program` — Rewards available where you have activity
6. `list_my_vouchers` — Your vouchers
7. `redeem_my_reward` — Redeem reward via on-chain transfer tx hash
8. `list_p2p_offers` — Active P2P swap offers
9. `create_p2p_offer` — Record P2P swap intent (escrow on-chain)
10. `accept_p2p_offer` — Accept P2P swap by id
11. `cancel_p2p_offer` — Cancel your own P2P offer
12. `lookup_gift_certificate` — Preview a gift certificate by code (LOYAL-XXXXXX)
13. `claim_gift_certificate` — Claim by code; binds it to your wallet (active → pending_mint)
14. `list_my_gift_certificates` — Certificates claimed by your wallet

### MCP Configuration for Claude/Cursor

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "loyal-spark": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://api.loyalspark.online/loyalty-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "HTTP_HEADER_x-api-key": "lsk_YOUR_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

| Method | Path | Price | Description |
|--------|------|-------|-------------|

| GET | /offers | $0.001 | P2P marketplace offers |
| POST | /register | free | One-time wallet registration (after SIWE) |
| POST | /prepare-transfer | $0.005 | ERC-20 transfer calldata (holder → any address) |
| POST | /redeem-reward | $0.01 | Redeem a reward via on-chain tx hash |
| POST | /offers | $0.01 | Create a P2P swap intent (escrow) |
| POST | /accept-offer | $0.01 | Accept a P2P offer (atomic swap) |
| POST | /cancel-offer | $0.005 | Cancel your own P2P offer |



## Payment Gateways

### MPP (Machine Payments Protocol)
- Gateway: https://api.loyalspark.online/mpp-gateway
- Currency: pathUSD on Tempo (also accepts USDC 0x20C0...b50)
- Flow: Request → 402 challenge → pay → retry with credential
- SDK: `npm install -g mppx`

### x402 (Coinbase Protocol) — v2
- Gateway: https://api.loyalspark.online/x402-gateway
- Currency: USDC on Base (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) · network CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`
- **Paid MCP:** `POST …/x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<tool_name>` — JSON-RPC `tools/call`, header `x-api-key: lsk_…` after payment. Tool ids + argument schemas: `supabase/functions/_shared/mcp-bazaar-tools.ts` (repo). Bazaar: 402 body includes `extensions.bazaar` for MCP routes.
- Facilitator (Base mainnet production): Coinbase CDP `https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402` (gateway uses CDP JWT when configured). Public facilitator reference: https://x402.org/facilitator (Sepolia-focused v2 listings differ from Base mainnet CDP)
- SDK: `@x402/fetch`, `@x402/evm`
- Spec: https://github.com/coinbase/x402

## Base MCP Custom Plugin (`send_calls`-ready calldata)

- Base URL: `https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-prepare`
- Purpose: GET endpoints returning EIP-5792 `send_calls`-compatible batches with Builder Code `bc_wdmnog7m` (ERC-8021) already baked into the calldata. Consumed by Base MCP custom plugins so Base Account signs and broadcasts.
- Auth: header `x-api-key: lsk_…` (merchant actions) or `rwk_…` (holder actions); `?api_key=` query fallback for surfaces that cannot forward headers.
- Response shape: `{ chainId: 8453, description, transactions: [{ to, data, value }], builder_code: "bc_wdmnog7m" }`.

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|--------|------|------|-------------|
| GET | /create-program | lsk_ | Deploy ERC-20 loyalty token |
| GET | /activate-program | lsk_ | Activate a deployed program |
| GET | /mint | lsk_ | Mint tokens to a wallet |
| GET | /transfer | lsk_ | Merchant ERC-20 transfer |
| GET | /recipient-transfer | rwk_ | Holder ERC-20 transfer |
| GET | /recipient-approve | rwk_ | Holder ERC-20 approve |

Plugin spec: https://github.com/oleksiihalytskyi/loyal-spark/blob/main/skills/loyal-spark/plugins/loyal-spark.md

## Agent Wallets

Agents can create Coinbase CDP MPC wallets for autonomous onchain operations:
- No private keys to manage
- Server-side transaction signing
- Support for `use_agent_wallet: true` in program creation / mint flows
- Endpoint: `POST https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-wallet` with `x-api-key: lsk_…` (separate Edge Function, not part of agent-api)

## P2P Marketplace (Escrow)

Atomic token swaps via smart contract:
1. Creator approves escrow for offer tokens
2. Creator calls createOffer() — tokens locked
3. Accepter approves escrow for request tokens
4. Accepter calls fillOffer() — atomic swap
5. Alternative: cancelOffer() returns tokens

Protocol fee: 0.5% on completed swaps.
